item.title: [−1] Manufacturing PMI eases to 54.7 in October from 55.1, below the 54.9 flash; export orders at six-month high
item.description:
Output and new orders growth slowed, finished-goods stocks rose at a record pace and selling-price inflation neared a four-year low. Composite flash was a four-month high. Steady, slightly slower.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Capital goods hiring cut

Why it matters: Still-solid expansion and easing price pressure support earnings and the inflation outlook, while record inventories hint at softer production ahead.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
